<!-- Release: v0.19.0 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; uses a separate `.debug` application ID. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- Refined player paths, animated transport icons, persistent lyrics and a shared artwork carousel for gestures and track changes.
- Springy glass menus, clear selection lenses, magnetic draggable tabs and more consistent contrast and spacing.
- Artwork-backed album/artist pages, album multiselect, interactive pinch layouts and simplified detail navigation.
- Organized song information, compact tag editing, required square artwork cropping and recoverable background tag jobs.

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/92 - Player motion, transport and artwork carousel.
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/93 - Glass morphs, selection lenses and modal materials.
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/94 - Interactive pinch, list fades and detail controls.
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/95 - Album and artist collection pages.
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/96 - Song information and tag-editor layout.
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/97 - Square cropping and artwork selection.
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/98 - Background tag jobs and progress history.

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.19.0-debug.apk` from **Assets** below (Android 8+).
2. Open the APK and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted. It updates the existing development app.
3. First use: open **More → Scan music**, choose **Folders to scan**, then **Scan now**.
